import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import Circle, Arc
BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" OCHRE = "#D4A72C" INK = "#263238"
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 10, "text.color": INK, "axes.labelcolor": INK, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "none", "lines.linewidth": 1.5, "text.usetex": False, })
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4), facecolor="white")
fig.text( 0.5, 0.945, "Why sampled cosine sums cancel", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=17, weight="bold" ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.825, r"$\cos\!\left(\frac{2\pi kn}{N}\right)" r"\cos\!\left(\frac{2\pi mn}{N}\right)" r"=\frac{1}{2}\left[" r"\cos\!\left(\frac{2\pi(k-m)n}{N}\right)" r"+\cos\!\left(\frac{2\pi(k+m)n}{N}\right)\right]$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=16 )
# Left: split the inner product into its two discrete frequencies. fig.text(0.055, 0.665, "1 Product-to-sum", fontsize=12, weight="bold", color=BLUE) fig.text(0.055, 0.575, "Split into two cosine sums:", fontsize=10.5) fig.text(0.065, 0.465, r"$p=k-m$", fontsize=16, color=BLUE) fig.text(0.065, 0.400, "difference frequency", fontsize=10, color=BLUE) fig.text(0.065, 0.300, r"$p=k+m$", fontsize=16, color=TEAL) fig.text(0.065, 0.235, "sum frequency", fontsize=10, color=TEAL)
# Center: a labeled mathematical illustration, not measured data. fig.text(0.495, 0.665, "Uniform phase steps", ha="center", fontsize=12, weight="bold") fig.text(0.495, 0.594, r"$\delta=2\pi p/N$ (radians)", ha="center", fontsize=10.5)
ax = fig.add_axes([0.355, 0.205, 0.280, 0.365]) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.set_xlim(-1.38, 1.55) ax.set_ylim(-1.23, 1.35) ax.axis("off")
N_example, p_example = 8, 1 theta = 2 * np.pi * p_example * np.arange(N_example) / N_example x, y = np.cos(theta), np.sin(theta)
ax.add_patch(Circle((0, 0), 1, fill=False, edgecolor=BLUE, linewidth=1.5)) for xx, yy in zip(x, y): ax.plot([0, xx], [0, yy], color=BLUE, alpha=0.16, linewidth=0.9)
ax.annotate("", xy=(1.34, 0), xytext=(-1.18, 0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=INK, alpha=0.4, lw=0.8)) ax.annotate("", xy=(0, 1.25), xytext=(0, -1.13), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=INK, alpha=0.4, lw=0.8)) ax.text(1.36, -0.12, "Re", fontsize=8, ha="center") ax.text(0.08, 1.23, "Im", fontsize=8, va="center") ax.text(-0.10, -0.15, "0", fontsize=7.5, ha="right")
ax.scatter(x, y, s=25, color=TEAL, zorder=4, edgecolors="white", linewidths=0.6) ax.scatter([x[0], x[1]], [y[0], y[1]], s=29, color=OCHRE, zorder=5, edgecolors=INK, linewidths=0.5) ax.plot([0, x[0]], [0, y[0]], color=BLUE, linewidth=1.3) ax.plot([0, x[1]], [0, y[1]], color=BLUE, linewidth=1.3)
ax.add_patch(Arc((0, 0), 0.86, 0.86, theta1=0, theta2=45, edgecolor=OCHRE, linewidth=1.8)) arc_end = 0.43 * np.array([np.cos(np.pi / 4), np.sin(np.pi / 4)]) arc_before = 0.43 * np.array([np.cos(np.pi / 4 - 0.12), np.sin(np.pi / 4 - 0.12)]) ax.annotate("", xy=arc_end, xytext=arc_before, arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=OCHRE, lw=1.2)) ax.text(0.49, 0.17, r"$\delta$", fontsize=10, color=INK) ax.text(1.04, 0.15, r"$n=0$", fontsize=8, ha="left") ax.text(0.79, 0.86, r"$n=1$", fontsize=8, ha="left") ax.text(-0.12, 1.07, r"$n=2$", fontsize=8, ha="right")
fig.text(0.495, 0.175, r"Illustration: $N=8,\ p=1$", ha="center", fontsize=9)
# Right: finite geometric-series cancellation. # Mathtext supports these sums directly, without the LaTeX \displaystyle command. fig.text(0.685, 0.665, "2 Phase cancellation", fontsize=12, weight="bold", color=TEAL) fig.text(0.685, 0.575, r"For integer $p$ with $N\nmid p$:", fontsize=10.5) fig.text( 0.825, 0.465, r"$\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}" r"\cos\!\left(\frac{2\pi pn}{N}\right)=0$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=15, color=TEAL ) fig.text( 0.685, 0.345, r"$z=e^{2\pi i p/N}\ne1,\qquad z^N=1$", fontsize=10.5 ) fig.text( 0.685, 0.255, r"$\mathrm{Re}\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}z^n" r"=\mathrm{Re}\frac{1-z^N}{1-z}=0$", fontsize=12 )
# Repeated phases remain valid when gcd(p, N) > 1. fig.text( 0.5, 0.090, r"$N\geq1$; $k,m,p\in\mathbb{Z}$. " r"If $N\mid p$, the cosine sum is $N$ instead; repeated phases are counted.", ha="center", fontsize=9 ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.035, r"The cosine inner product is zero when both " r"$N\nmid(k-m)$ and $N\nmid(k+m)$.", ha="center", fontsize=9, color=BLUE )
